user.title: Set up Todo Overlay
user.description: Todo Overlay works against your existing todo.* entities directly - there's nothing to configure here. Select Submit to finish setup, then add the "Todo Overlay" card to a dashboard.

abort.already_configured: Todo Overlay is already set up - only one instance is needed, since it works across every todo.* entity automatically.

configure_broker.title: MQTT broker for linked lists
configure_broker.description: Optional - only needed if you want to link a list with another Home Assistant instance. Leave this unconfigured for normal, non-linked use.

data_description.mqtt_transport: "tcp" for a direct/LAN broker, "websockets" for one reached through a reverse proxy's WSS (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) without needing a dedicated forwarded port.
data_description.mqtt_ws_path: Only used when connection type is websockets - the path the broker's websocket listener expects (Mosquitto's default is /mqtt).

configure_item_links.title: Item links
configure_item_links.description: Optional - a once-off default parent (e.g. a "Brodie" section) that new item links auto-file under, so linking an item to your shared list doesn't need a picker every time. The target list itself is picked automatically too, whenever exactly one MQTT-linked list is configured ({linked_list_count} found right now) - with zero or several, only the toggle below applies; item links still work, they just file at the target list's own root instead. Leaving all of this alone changes nothing.
